prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: It was **Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez**, a 60-year-old lawyer crowned **Miss Universe Buenos Aires 2024**. She was celebrated as a breakthrough for older women, though she did not win the national Miss Argentina title or the global Miss Universe competition.
